jurisdiction.name: Myanmar
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Most official Myanmar government websites, including the national legislation portal and the communications and planning ministries, could not be accessed during this review, and no national AI law, strategy or AI guidance was found published on official sites. The 2025 Cybersecurity Law appears to contain no AI provisions, but its official text could not be read. A Digital Economy Roadmap 2030 and a Digital Government Master Plan may contain AI content and are listed as leads.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but most official Myanmar websites could not be accessed, so the finding that no national AI documents exist rests largely on web searches. Myanmar is marked for a later retry.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Myanmar's laws, government, ministries and the central bank were searched in English and Burmese for AI laws, strategies and guidance. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category; an unofficial translation of the cybersecurity law shows no AI provisions, and two digital plans are listed as leads. The legislation portal and several ministry websites were unavailable, so the official text of the cybersecurity law remains to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. mlis.gov.mm reset/503; motc.gov.mm HTTP 521; mopf.gov.mm refused/unresolvable; mofa.gov.mm, mcf.gov.mm and mdeb.gov.mm unreachable. cbm.gov.mm reached (no AI results). Cybersecurity Law No. 1/2025 checked only in an unofficial translation (no AI terms); not recorded. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched for AI laws and AI provisions (English and Burmese). The Myanmar Law Information System (mlis.gov.mm) was unreachable (connection reset; HTTP 503). The Cybersecurity Law (Law No. 1/2025, in force 30 July 2025 by Notification 113/2025) was checked via a discovery copy of its English translation: no AI, algorithm or deepfake provisions, so not recorded. No data protection law with automated-decision rules; no AI bill found. Searched, nothing found.; Government: No national AI strategy, AI policy, AI governance framework or public-sector AI guidance found. Digital Economy Roadmap 2030 and Digital Government Master Plan 2023-2030 held as leads (AI content unverified; official sites unreachable).; Ministries: Ministry of Transport and Communications (motc.gov.mm returned HTTP 521), Ministry of Planning and Finance (unreachable), Ministry of Foreign Affairs (connection reset); education, science and technology, health searched by web search: no AI documents found.; Regulators: Central Bank of Myanmar site search for 'artificial intelligence' and 'AI': no results. No separate data protection authority exists; cyber security functions sit with the ministry under the Cybersecurity Law; no AI-specific regulator documents found.. Not reached: mlis.gov.mm (legislation portal) unreachable; motc.gov.mm unreachable (HTTP 521); mopf.gov.mm unreachable (proxy CONNECT refused; WebFetch DNS failure); mofa.gov.mm (connection reset); mcf.gov.mm, mdeb.gov.mm unreachable. Could not verify: Official text of the Cybersecurity Law 2025 on mlis.gov.mm (portal unreachable); absence of AI provisions based on an unofficial English translation used for discovery only. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

leads.title: Myanmar Digital Economy Roadmap 2030
leads.issuing_authority: Digital Economy Development Committee (chaired under the de facto authorities' administration)
leads.note: Reported as launched in December 2024 (strategic pillars and 77 action plans); a roadmap PDF is linked from the Ministry of Planning and Finance site (mopf.gov.mm 'RoadMap for Websites.pdf'), but mopf.gov.mm and motc.gov.mm could not be reached on 2026-10-12 (curl and WebFetch both failed), so its AI content, title and date are unverified. Check whether it contains an AI pillar or AI action items; record as strategy only if it does.
